# c4-capabilities

- `capabilities.py <prework/data> out`: statewide shape of medical capability layers, regional ratios, coastal dialysis surge.
- `out/summary.json`: its output.
- `out/dialysis_centers_geocoded.csv`: 355 CMS dialysis centers, Census Geocoder (Public_AR_Current) batch, 2026-10-27. `location_status`: geocoded_census_exact 242, geocoded_census_non_exact 81, unmatched 32 (505 stations). Public domain.
